llm_summary: TASMAC, Tamil Nadu’s state liquor‑marketing corporation, has rolled out a mandatory three‑year rotation policy for its retail staff, moving employees between outlets on a set schedule. The aim is to balance workforce distribution, fill staffing gaps and boost operational efficiency across its network of liquor stores. This policy was approved at the corporation’s 224th board meeting.
